scripts.install: npx rimraf backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/package-lock.json frontend/package-lock.json frontend/.next && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && npx rimraf backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && docker compose up -d
scripts.reset-docker: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.seed: docker exec mongodb-workshop mongosh workshop --eval "db.users.drop(); db.vehicles.drop()" && docker exec -i mongodb-workshop mongosh workshop < backend/config/mongodb/seed.js
